methods.label: ThriveDesk OAuth
methods.note: Authenticate through your normal ThriveDesk sign-in; no API key is needed.

auth.guide:
Connect to the hosted ThriveDesk MCP server over Streamable HTTP. ThriveDesk uses OAuth through your normal sign-in; no API key is needed. Add the remote server URL in your MCP client, then approve the connection in the ThriveDesk browser page. Choose the organization and access preset; Read-only is selected by default in the approval flow. The connection is limited by your account’s organization permissions and the permissions you grant. For Claude Code, register the same endpoint with this command:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http thrivedesk https://mcp.thrivedesk.com
```

For Cursor, VS Code, and other clients supporting remote MCP, use `https://mcp.thrivedesk.com` as a Streamable HTTP server. See the official docs for client-specific setup, available actions, permission controls, and revoking access. The docs also explain approval scope and safe revocation.
